item.title: Bahamas DEA Row, Teen Shooting, Severance Dispute
item.ns0:title: Bahamas DEA Row, Teen Shooting, Severance Dispute
item.description:
Tonight on Our News, a deepening diplomatic row between The Bahamas and the United States unfolds over allegations of unauthorized undercover DEA operations, drawing responses from top officials on both sides. Meanwhile, shockwaves ripple through the community following the broad-daylight shooting of a 14-year-old boy, as former Grand Lucayan Resort workers demand clarity over ongoing severance disputes. Plus, proposed industrial expansion plans in Grand Bahama remain on hold over environmental concerns, while Cabbage Beach vendors face mounting uncertainty ahead of a looming relocation deadline. Tune in for all these stories, local sports highlights, and your complete weather forecast!
